record_title: Uniform rational approximation on the negative ray: obstructions to a no-assumptions shared-denominator theorem
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The 2025 source article was inspected in full-text form, and no published correction addressing its Theorem 1 was located in the searches checked. The elementary compactification characterization is not claimed as new in isolation. The record does not determine the optimal simultaneous common-denominator Halphen rate for the phi-functions and does not dispute the reported numerical tables for those specific targets. No independent validation is asserted.
